prs.title: feat(queue): add priority lanes
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body:
Adds named lanes to a queue. Jobs added with `lane` are picked up from the highest lane first.

Closes #296

prs.title: fix(worker): release lock when handler throws synchronously
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.body:
A handler that throws before its first `await` skipped the `finally` path, so the lock stayed until it expired and the job looked stuck.

Fixes #298

prs.title: chore: reduce redis memory footprint
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: Busy queues keep a lot of finished entries around and the Redis instance grows without bound. This trims the memory profile and shortens a couple of internal key prefixes.

prs.title: docs: fix typo in retries guide
prs.author: tidewatcher
prs.diff:
--- a/docs/retries.md
+++ b/docs/retries.md
@@ -12,1 +12,1 @@
-Set `attemps` to the number of tries.
+Set `attempts` to the number of tries.

prs.title: fix(lanes): don't starve default lane when high lane is busy
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body: After four jobs from a higher lane the worker now takes one from the default lane.

prs.title: Revert "feat(queue): add priority lanes"
prs.author: harbormaster
prs.body: This reverts #301 together with the follow-up #312. Lanes deadlock when combined with sticky concurrency, see #313. We will come back to this with a different design.

prs.title: feat(cli): add quaykit inspect --json
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.body: Machine-readable output for `quaykit inspect`, so that scripts do not have to parse the table.

prs.title: ci: cache pnpm store in GitHub Actions
prs.author: bollard-dev
prs.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/test.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/test.yml
@@ -14,3 +14,5 @@ jobs:
       - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          cache: pnpm
       - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

issues.title: Support job priorities
issues.body: We need urgent jobs to overtake a backlog of slow ones.

issues.title: Job stuck in active after handler throws
issues.body: If the handler throws right away the job stays in active for the whole lock duration.

issues.title: Worker deadlock with lanes and sticky concurrency
issues.body: Two workers end up waiting on each other once a sticky group sits in a higher lane.
